ios.desc:
Featured as App Store Editor's Pick of the Week.

Paste a link, pick a style — your social media post becomes a beautiful card in seconds.

## Web Cards

Paste any URL and Kosaku extracts the content into a clean card. One-tap AI summary turns long articles into sharp highlights.

## Social Media Cards

Works with Twitter/X, Threads, Instagram, and more. Just copy a public post link and generate a card instantly.

## Music Cards

Copy a music link to create a card with album art and lyrics.

## Markdown Rendering

Render Markdown content visually — code blocks, quotes, and lists look great on a card. Perfect for developers and writers sharing technical content.

## Customize Everything

- Gradient backgrounds and solid color themes
- Custom fonts
- Flexible layouts
- High-resolution export

---

Kosaku Pro is an optional paid subscription that unlocks member-exclusive features.

The subscription renews automatically within 24 hours before expiration. To cancel, do so at least 24 hours before the renewal date.
Manage subscriptions: iPhone Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions

Privacy Policy: https://kosaku.yichenlab.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

show_hn.title: Show HN: Transform Web Content into Elegant Social Cards

quotes.text:
Hi Hacker News,

I've created Kosaku, a minimalist card generator that transforms web content and music links into beautifully designed social cards.

Core Features:

Transform any web page into an elegant card with one-click summary
Generate stylish music cards from streaming platform links
Multi-platform support for major social media and content platforms
Simple two-step process for card creation.

Try it out and let me know what you think! The app is designed to enhance content sharing while maintaining a clean, distraction-free experience.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1611559010
Goolge Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hugo.card
